Hi yall. You might be wondering why I'm typing an announcement here and not in arcaniabot-help. Here's why:

I figured out how to make custom aliases for Avrae.
So, here's `!asc` (airship check), added as a server alias (works for everyone, as long as they're in this server).

You use it as follows: `!asc role level`
where `role` is of course `captain`/`pilot`/`gunner`/`mechanic`, but you can shorten it to as little as the first letter,
and `level` is `u`/`t`/`a` for untrained/trained/ace respectively.
So for example the result you see above is me running `!asc m a`.


This will read all the info it needs from your active character sheet. You don't need to have any custom skill for gunner etc., you just need to remember your training level.
It will also choose your better stat out of the two assigned to each of the airship skills.
If you run it as untrained, it will do the DC20 INT check first, and only roll the actual skill check if you succeeded. And it will tell you if you crit fail and the station is disabled.

I wish everyone tailwind and good rolls.
